bibl.title: Menander, Epitrepontes 807 and the Suffix of the Feminine Perfect Active Participle in Fourth-Century Athens.
bibl.seg: Ben Cartlidge, Menander, Epitrepontes 807 and the Suffix of the Feminine Perfect Active Participle in Fourth-Century Athens.
bibl.note: In Epitrepontes 807, P. Mich. Inv. 4752c (= MP3 1301.04; LDAB 2643) might give evidence that Menander used the same morphology as contemporary Attic inscriptions.
